title: groundstation field test №17: the 2 cards stops 28 to 30 set out to fix, re-run on 0.52.0
heading: THE FIELD TEST №17
sub: groundstation · 2 prompts re-run · 2 live artifacts · 2 fixed, 0 partly, 0 the same · October 26, 2026 · Development Seed labs
lede: The 2 cards from field test 16 that stops 28 to 30 were charted to fix, asked again in the same words on main at 0.52.0 (PRs 93 to 95, landed the same day). The Rolling Fork compare now names its scaling factors, and the Lake Victoria call that needed a local patch in field test 16 runs clean with no patch. The layers read as a collection name, and at 390 px the credit sits inside the attribution bar. Each learning opens with its verdict, grounded only in the new output: 2 fixed, 0 partly, 0 the same.

cases.answer: Rolling Fork gives the same NDVI as field test 16, 0.198 before and 0.2274 after (delta 0.0294, 14.8%), and the result now names the scaling factors for both dates. The data is Sentinel-2 L2A tile 15SXS, S2A_15SXS_20230219_0_L2A before (cloud 45.558468) and S2B_15SXS_20230326_0_L2A after (cloud 0.767861, 2 days after the tornado). Both after and before carry band_scaling: scale 0.0001 and offset 0 with declared_offset -0.1 on 24 bands including nir, scale 0.001 on aot, scale 0.001 unit cm on wvp. The scaling_note says one clause per date: scale 0.0001 and offset 0 applied for 2023-03-26 and for 2023-02-19, and for each Earth Search already took the -0.1 offset out of its pixels. The means could not move against field test 16: a normalized difference is a ratio, so the scale cancels, and the -0.1 offset is already in the pixels of both of these 2023 scenes, so nothing is left for compare_dates to add. The note names no date where the offset is still in the pixels, so I cannot say what a pre-2022 scene would show from this run. An NDVI mean over the whole box still says nothing about the damage track.
cases.artifact_label: swipe: Rolling Fork NDVI with the adjuster's notes ↗
cases.learning: Fixed. Field test 16 said "Scaling is applied, but the factors are not named in the default compare_dates result", with "no scaling_note, and no scale or offset values in this result". Now the default compare_dates result carries band_scaling under both after and before (scale 0.0001, offset 0, declared_offset -0.1 on 24 bands, plus the aot and wvp scales) and a scaling_note with one clause per date: "scale 0.0001 and offset 0 applied for 2023-03-26 (Earth Search already took the -0.1 offset out of its pixels); scale 0.0001 and offset 0 applied for 2023-02-19 (Earth Search already took the -0.1 offset out of its pixels)". The factors no longer need an apply_scaling=False run or a compute_statistics call to be read. The means 0.2274 and 0.198 and the delta 0.0294 are unchanged from field test 16, as the note's offset clause and the ratio predict. The same card still shows the stop 21 caveat naming scene S2A_15SXS_20230219_0_L2A at 46% against a 20% threshold, stack_facts_ignored returning geocoded and adjuster, and both notes strings in the result. Not checked this run: the apply_scaling=False path, the out_path outside the repo, how many times each note string lands on the page, a scene older than 2022, and a non-ratio expression.

cases.answer: The call that failed as shipped in field test 16 now succeeds with no patch, the six layers read "ESA WorldCover 2021" with the tile id beside them, and at 390 px the Development Seed credit is no longer a separate box: it sits inside the attribution bar's own text. search_imagery found 6 scenes, all from 2021-01-01, covering 100.0% of the area (best single scene 47.0%), and render_map wrote the page with no KeyError. At 390 by 844 the Layers fold is closed on load and opens on a tap. The #credit div is display none; the attribution bar is the same box as before (left 10, top 790, right 380, bottom 834, 370 by 44) and its text now begins "groundstation · Development Seed labs · STAC + TiTiler". At 1280 by 800 the credit div shows (left 12, top 759, right 384.5, bottom 776), and the attribution bar (left 857.8, top 766, right 1270, bottom 790) reads "MapLibre | OpenFreeMap ..." without the credit text.
cases.artifact_label: map: Lake Victoria, ESA WorldCover 2021, with legend (clean call, no patch) ↗
cases.learning: Fixed. Field test 16 said the call "fails as shipped with KeyError 'id'", that each layer read "2021-01-01" and not the collection plus date, and that at 390 px the credit (803 to 820) is a "credit inside the attribution box on both axes" (bar 790 to 834). On 0.52.0 the same two calls ran once each with no patch and no layer name and returned a page: no KeyError, and the tiles come from mosaic ids of the form pc1.<digits>.<hash>, so the searchid read works for esa-worldcover. All 6 layers read "ESA WorldCover 2021" with the tile id as the detail line. At 390 by 844 the credit div is hidden (display none) and its text is the start of MapLibre's attribution bar, so it cannot sit on the data credits; the bar is the same 370 by 44 box as before. At 1280 by 800 the credit div still shows and the attribution bar does not carry it, so the wide layout is unchanged. The viewport was set before the page loaded. Not checked: a real phone, widths between 390 and 500, whether the longer attribution text wraps to a third line on a narrower phone, and other collections whose register answer may differ.
